english.title: Manufacturer of electrical equipment fail to take action where equipment considered not to be in conformity
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a manufacturer of electrical equipment namely **(..SPECIFY EQUIPMENT..), which you

(A)_[considered]_
(B)_[had reason to believe]_

was not in conformity with Part 2 of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016 and you had placed on the market, failed to take immediately the corrective measures necessary to

(C)_[bring the electrical equipment into conformity]_
(D)_[withdraw the electrical equipment]_
(E)_[recall the electrical equipment]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 12(1), 50(1) and 51(1) of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: There is also an offence of failing to inform the market surveillance authority and the competent national authority of any other member states where the equipment is made available on the market under regulation 12(2) of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016, H18741.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
